46/G.goal: Explain how to design and statistically evaluate an empirical user study for an XR system implementation, from representative participants and tasks to appropriate significance testing.
46/G.achieves: It provides the evaluation foundation for completing the case-study implementation stage, enabling the learner to interpret experimental evidence about an XR system with confidence.

46/O1.goal: Explain how to design an empirical user experiment for an XR system implementation, including representative participants, representative tasks, sample size, and an assignment structure that limits practice effects.
46/O1.achieves: It supports the course's practical case study by giving the learner the basis for setting up a valid empirical evaluation of an implemented XR system.

46/O2.goal: Explain how to evaluate empirical XR experiment data by determining whether differences are statistically significant and selecting an appropriate parametric or non-parametric test.
46/O2.achieves: It supports the course aim of implementing an XR system with confidence by enabling the learner to interpret experimental results defensibly.
